title: Segments formed from argument words
statement: Let $w_0,\ldots,w_{n-1}$ be a list of Boolean words, and form its argument segments by marking each word except the last as doubled. For every index $i<n$, segment $i$ is the pair consisting of $w_i$ and the flag that is true exactly when $i+1<n$.
